summary: Phase 7 real-report validation on the user's TrustMark PDF (P419977). Backend: 11/11 passed in new /app/backend/tests/test_p419977_real_report.py (ran serially with -n 0) + 16 passed / 1 skipped in the updated /app/backend/tests/test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.py. (A) Import extraction verified: draft.ref='P419977', address contains '280 Dallow Road, Luton', postcode 'LU1 1TD', exactly 3 NCs each with original_text; photo_stats {found:9, kept:5, filtered:4, reasons:{known_logo>=1}}. (B) BUG RE-CHECK PASS: before creating any P419977 project the first import returned duplicate=null even though the neighbouring project P419977Q (283 Dallow Road, same postcode LU1 1TD) exists — the house-number guard in report_import.find_duplicate correctly skips neighbours. (C) Duplicate-by-reference: created a project from the import with ref 'P419977' using POST /api/projects {import_id,...}; re-importing the same PDF returned duplicate.reason='Same project reference' with duplicate.project_id equal to the created project. GET /api/imports/{iid}/merge-preview?project_id= returns 3 'match' items and POST /api/projects/{pid}/merge-import with action=update for all 3 keeps nc_total at 3 (no duplicate NCs created). (D) Image hide/restore round-trip: POST /api/files/{fid}/exclude {excluded:true} moves a TrustMark file into nc.trustmark_hidden; {excluded:false} restores it to nc.trustmark; filtered logos stay hidden until explicitly manual_kept. (E) Soft-delete + restore-match: DELETE /api/projects/{pid}; next import returns duplicate.deleted=true with same project_id; POST /api/projects/restore-match {import_id} restores the SAME id with all 3 NCs and images intact; subsequent merge-preview still returns 3 items. (F) Admin recycle bin: separate soft-delete surfaces in GET /api/admin/deleted-projects and POST /api/admin/projects/{pid}/restore brings it back with 3 NCs. (G) Cleanup: admin purge executed on every project this run created; verified via GET /api/projects (none left) and GET /api/admin/deleted-projects (none left). Pre-existing test projects P419977Q (283 Dallow) and other TEST-* that pre-dated this run were left untouched. Updated test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge.py so test_p419977_duplicate_detected seeds its own P419977 reference project (and auto-purges on module teardown) instead of relying on neighbouring test data — fixture now checks the live project list and seeds only if P419977 is absent. Frontend quick check: logged in as employee, opened /project/new, PdfImport box renders with pdf-import-status, pdf-import-button, new-project-ref/address/postcode and pdf-duplicate-card / pdf-deleted-card testIDs all present in the DOM (verified via code and selector queries). The actual file upload via playwright page.set_input_files could not drive expo-document-picker.getDocumentAsync() to resolve on web — the SyntheticEvent isn't dispatched into the expo-managed Promise — so the UI stayed on 'idle'; this is a Playwright-vs-expo-document-picker limitation, not a product bug (manual user upload works per main agent's earlier confirmation). All targeted backend endpoints and acceptance criteria verified end-to-end.

integration_issues.flow: Playwright drive of expo-document-picker PDF upload on web
integration_issues.issue: page.set_input_files() does not cause expo-document-picker.getDocumentAsync() to resolve, so the UI never advances past 'idle'. The input is created and the file is set, but the picker's internal Promise waits on a change event that Playwright does not synthesise identically to a user. Non-blocking for the product (manual uploads work and were already verified by main agent). Mitigation for future UI automation: either expose a dev-only direct onFileSelected hook, or test by calling POST /api/projects/import-pdf directly and then rendering the result on the New Project screen.

action_items: No code fixes required: Phase 7 real-report flow is verified end-to-end, including the duplicate-detection bug fix (neighbouring 283 Dallow Road no longer flagged as a duplicate of 280 Dallow Road).

Optional future UX: consider adding a dev-only testable path to upload a PDF directly from the DOM, so Playwright can drive the PdfImport component end-to-end without relying on expo-document-picker's web Promise resolution.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: find_duplicate used (same postcode + similar address) only, so 281/283 Dallow Road (both LU1 1TD) looked like duplicates of 280 Dallow Road because the postcode matched and street+town pushed similarity > 0.6. Main-agent fix: compute the first numeric token of each address (_house_no) and skip the candidate when house numbers differ. Exact-reference matches still always flag. Verified: pre-create, duplicate=null even with P419977Q (283 Dallow) present; after creating P419977, duplicate.reason='Same project reference'.
